Oquirrh Lake, 50+ miles of trails, SoDa Row, and Downtown Daybreak define the lifestyle. Tommy Wolf lives in Daybreak and specializes in this market.
- [Herriman Real Estate](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/herriman): Herriman is one of Utah's fastest-growing cities, offering newer construction, mountain views, and family-oriented neighborhoods. Tommy Wolf serves buyers and sellers throughout Herriman.
- [Riverton Real Estate](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/riverton): Riverton offers established neighborhoods, strong schools, and convenient access to both Salt Lake City and Utah's ski resorts. Tommy Wolf helps clients buy and sell in Riverton.

## Daybreak Neighborhoods

- [Daybreak Neighborhood Guides](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods): Guides to every Daybreak village, covering price ranges, home types, HOA structure, build years, and who each village fits best.
- [Founders Park Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/founders-park-village): Where Daybreak Began — Classic Architecture, Established Community. Price range: $350K–$1.1M+. HOA: DCA Master: $433.50/quarter (2026). Founder's Village Phase 1 homes pay $334.50/quarter (internet not included). Confirm which phase before purchase. Some condos/townhomes have sub-association fees — verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [Eastlake Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/eastlake-village): Premier Homes, Promenade Park & the Lake's Eastern Shore. Price range: $500K–$1.2M+. HOA: DCA: $433.50/quarter. Some townhomes carry sub-association fees. Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [North Shore Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/north-shore-village): Affordable Daybreak Living on the Lake's Northern Shore. Price range: $380K–$750K. HOA: DCA: $433.50/quarter. North Shore Townhomes sub-assoc: $825/quarter ($275/month) — exterior maintenance, landscaping, snow, insurance, reserves. 20 lots carry additional $25/month garbage removal BSA. Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [Lake Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/lake-village): Waterfront and Water-View Homes Along Oquirrh Lake's Western Shore. Price range: $450K–$1.2M+. HOA: DCA: $433.50/quarter. Lake Village Boathouse BSA: $33/quarter additional (specific lots — verify). Lake Village Townhomes sub-assoc: $876/quarter ($292/month). Lake Village Condos: contact Treo (801) 355-1136. Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [Creekside Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/creekside-village): Brookside Park, Fish Hook Creek & a Vibrant Mix of Homes. Price range: $430K–$800K. HOA: DCA: $433.50/quarter. Creekside Townhomes sub-assoc: $717/quarter ($239/month). Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [Garden Park](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/garden-park): Utah's Largest Active Adult Community, Steps from Oquirrh Lake. Price range: $350K–$900K+. HOA: DCA Master: $433.50/quarter (separate). Garden Park Clubhouse: $180/quarter ($60/month). SF Sub-Assoc: $246/quarter → total $426/quarter ($142/month). Townhome: $795/quarter → total $975/quarter ($325/month). Condos: $1,161/quarter → total $1,341/quarter ($447/month). NOTE: Condo owners have THREE separate assessment payments. Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [SoDa Row](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/soda-row): Daybreak's Urban Core — Walk to Everything. Price range: $400K–$700K. HOA: DCA: $433.50/quarter. SoDa Row Townhomes sub-assoc: $699/quarter ($233/month). 20 lots carry $25/month garbage removal BSA. Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [South Station Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/south-station-village): Transit-Oriented Living in the Heart of Downtown Daybreak. Price range: $400K–$650K. HOA: DCA: $433.50/quarter. South Station Townhomes sub-assoc: $639/quarter ($213/month). Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [Highland Park Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/highland-park-village): The Loop, The Hub & Daybreak's First Upper Village. Price range: $475K–$900K. HOA: DCA: $433.50/quarter. Highland Park Townhomes sub-assoc: $642/quarter ($214/month). Single-family typically DCA only. Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [Heights Park Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/heights-park-village): Elevated Views & a Broad Range of Homes in Daybreak's Upper Villages. Price range: $425K–$850K. HOA: DCA: $433.50/quarter. Heights Park Townhomes by Holmes BSA: $636.33 + $433.50 = ~$1,069.83/quarter (~$356.61/month). Heights Park by Sego BSA: $507.90 + $433.50 = ~$941.40/quarter (~$313.80/month). SF typically DCA only. Verify at homewisedocs.com.
- [SpringHouse Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/springhouse-village): Resort-Style 55+ Living in Daybreak's Upper Villages. Price range: $400K–$700K+. HOA: DCA Master: $433.50/quarter (separate). SpringHouse Dues: $610.50/quarter. Reserve Contribution: $63/quarter. Total sub-assoc: $673.50/quarter ($224.50/month). Optional Insurance Assessment (36 units): $81/quarter ($27/month). Verify at homewisedocs.com.
